SELECT t.USER_ID AS teacher_id, t.USER_NM AS teacher_nm, t.EMAIL AS email, tc.lecture_count AS lecture_count FROM TB_MA_MEMBER t INNER JOIN ( SELECT SUBJECT_TEACHER, COUNT(*) AS lecture_count FROM TB_TOP_MST WHERE SUBJECT_TEACHER IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_TEACHER <> '' GROUP BY SUBJECT_TEACHER ) tc ON t.USER_ID = tc.SUBJECT_TEACHER
WHERE LOWER(t.USER_NM) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.USER_NM

SELECT t.USER_ID AS teacher_id, t.USER_NM AS teacher_nm, t.EMAIL AS email, COALESCE(tc.lecture_count, 0) AS lecture_count FROM TB_MA_MEMBER t LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SUBJECT_TEACHER, COUNT(*) AS lecture_count FROM TB_TOP_MST WHERE SUBJECT_TEACHER IS NOT NULL AND SUBJECT_TEACHER <> '' GROUP BY SUBJECT_TEACHER ) tc ON t.USER_ID = tc.SUBJECT_TEACHER WHERE t.USER_ID = #{teacherId} LIMIT 1
